METHOD set_receive_qty.

  " 이번에 저장되는 아이템들 읽기
  READ ENTITIES OF zr_a10_mkpf IN LOCAL MODE
  ENTITY GoodsReceiptItem
  FIELDS ( Ebeln Ebelp Menge Bwart ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
  RESULT DATA(lt_item).

  " PO 참조 없는 이동유형(311/511)은 제외
  DELETE lt_item WHERE Ebeln IS INITIAL OR Ebelp IS INITIAL.
  CHECK lt_item IS NOT INITIAL.
